formData.name: Chaos Lab
formData.description: High-impact avant-garde style that blends anti-design, glitch, op-art, maximalism, and vaporwave cues.
formData.philosophy: Break visual comfort, maximize contrast, and keep interaction intensity consistently high.
formData.bodyFont: JetBrains Mono, Noto Sans SC, monospace
doList: Make hover, active, and focus states aggressive.
Keep glitch-like behavior consistent across core components.
dontList: Do not soften colors into neutral palettes.
Do not use overly gentle transitions.
Do not revert to standard enterprise UI patterns.
aiRules: Allow misalignment, skew, border jumps, and hard-cut transitions.
Use saturated neon highlights and glitch-like shadow offsets.
All components must include strong hover, active, and focus deltas.
